name: hundred.org
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 240 images have no alt attribute.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: hundred.org scores 72 out of 100 (C). 6 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 38 pass. Fix first: 24 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 24 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /en, /en/innovations, /en/collections, /en/spotlights and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 240 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Meta Pixel (2 requests), and cookies _fbp.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 78 elements on /en, /en/innovations, /en/collections, for example .white[href$="innovations"] and .white[href$="collections"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 15 elements on /en, /en/innovations, /en/collections, for example a[href="/en"] and .gap8 > a[target="_blank"]:nth-child(1). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The page fits a 390 px phone screen
Images are no more than twice the size shown
Every external link that was checked answered
